title: Portolan NL — Cloud-Native Dutch Geodata
note: A community Portolan catalog of Dutch open geodata (Rijkswaterstaat, Kadaster, CBS, RVO, RCE, Beeldmateriaal, TU Delft, VRO), hosted on Source Cooperative and listed in the Portolan registry. The collections are mirrors: each names its own producer, which is what a layer's attribution credits.
